subject: fsaverage
source_space: ico-5 white-matter surface, 20484 sources, fixed cortical-normal orientation

sensors.coverage: scalp above the plane through LPA, RPA and nasion + 3 cm

patches: geodesic radius along the cortical mesh (MNE: shortest paths along mesh edges), uniform (area-weighted) current density
d50: depth at which the area fraction of the cortex at that depth with SNR_OPM > SNR_SQUID drops below 50 % (area-weighted, 2-mm bins with >= 30 sources); null if censored (see 'd50' per size)
sphere_model: tangential dipole / spherical cap of the same area on the brain surface (h = 95 mm, b = 80 mm)
